desc: The graphical target currently runs at maxcpus=1 idle=nop, which is a severe daily-driver limitation: one P-core out of 14. The pieces exist separately — ticket 120/121 own the maxcpus=14 candidate and smoke, 123 owns the revised maxcpus=2 proof, and 006 owns cpufreq, with the full kernel already carrying CONFIG_SMP=y, CONFIG_HOTPLUG_CPU=y, CONFIG_CPU_FREQ=y and CONFIG_ARM_APPLE_SOC_CPUFREQ=y. What is missing is an INTEGRATION object: dwm plus more than one core. TASK: once 123 (or 121) establishes a working SMP bootarg set, build the graphical object with it — one variable changed from the proven 59622e78 — and only then consider cpufreq. Sequence deliberately: SMP first at fixed frequency, then cpufreq, since the 2026-07-24 maxcpus=2 attempt reached kernel vectoring with no output and mixing the two would make a failure unattributable. WATCH thermals with no fan control and no temperature reading until 165 lands.
author: claude
